Dear Pulse Foundation Team,

I am writing to apply for the Communication & Events Intern position at Pulse Foundation. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in social media management, content creation, and AI-assisted workflows, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your impactful communication and events while learning from your AI-driven approach.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites. I also run mirook.com, where I've implemented structured data and AI-focused optimizations. I regularly use AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude to streamline content drafting and research, and I'm eager to bring these habits to your team.

I have real experience publishing on LinkedIn, Instagram, and Facebook, and I'm comfortable with Canva, video editing, and Mailchimp. I'm proactive, creative, and thrive in fast-moving environments. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and I'm fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1.

I would love to discuss how I can support your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

cover_letter:
Dear Pulse Foundation Team,

I am thrilled to apply for the Communication & Events Intern position at Pulse Foundation. As a junior digital marketer with a strong foundation in content creation, social media management, and AI-assisted workflows, I am drawn to your mission of using AI to work smarter and amplify impact. I am eager to bring my hands-on experience and enthusiasm to your team.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted blog content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. I have direct experience publishing and managing content on LinkedIn, Instagram, and Facebook, including community engagement and content creation. I am comfortable with Canva for visual content and have used video editing tools like CapCut for short-form content. I also have experience with email campaigns and website updates, which aligns with your needs for newsletters and web management.

AI is integral to my daily work. I regularly use ChatGPT and Claude to draft content, research topics, and streamline workflows. On my own project, mirook.com, I have implemented structured data and AI-focused optimizations to improve visibility across AI search engines. I am excited about the opportunity to test and refine AI-assisted workflows for your team, and I am always looking for ways to automate manual tasks.

I am a proactive, creative, and collaborative team player. I thrive in fast-paced environments and am comfortable with flexible schedules, including occasional evenings for events. I am trilingual in English, Turkish, and Dutch (B1), which I believe is a plus for your diverse networks.

I am eager to contribute to your communication and events, capture stories that bring your mission to life, and learn from your AI-driven Communications Lead. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can support your team.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok
